title: Care Plan Desk Cross-Notice: The Ceiling on a Custody Declaration
content:
The ceiling above which a custody declaration is not taken under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes is raised for a piece covered by a plan in force under the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans, and how far depends on whether the chain sold the piece.

## The notice

Where the piece is covered by a plan in force and the chain sold it, the declaration is held to the largest amount the programme answers for while a piece is in its care. Where the piece is covered by a plan in force but the chain did not sell it, it is held to sixty thousand (60000 USD). Where the piece is not covered by a plan in force, it is held to twenty thousand (20000 USD).

A plan in force is a protection plan on the piece at the active standing. The chain sold the piece where an original sales receipt is recorded against the registration.

## The ceiling by programme

| Covered by a plan in force | Chain sold the piece | Ceiling (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the programme's largest amount for a piece in its care |
| yes | no | 60000 |
| no | either | 20000 |

The largest amount each programme answers for while a piece is in its care is 10000 USD under the Belrose Standard Trade-In, 50000 USD under the Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee, 75000 USD under the Bridal Upgrade Guarantee, 150000 USD under the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee, 400000 USD under the Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege and 300000 USD under the Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme.

## Readings

- A covered piece the chain sold, under the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee: the ceiling is 150000 USD.
- A covered piece the chain did not sell, under the same programme: 60000 USD.
- An uncovered piece, under any programme: 20000 USD.
